shows.name: Layover Card Show
shows.description: Our first ever hosted show! Come shop dozens of vendors, trade with fellow collectors, pull some packs, and hang out with the Vancouver card community. Free entry for attendees.
shows.vendor_description: Grab a table and sell to hundreds of local collectors. Tables include a 6ft table and two chairs. Setup starts at 8am.

shows.name: Dreamliner Card Show
shows.description: Round two! Building on the success of our July show, this one goes even bigger. More vendors, more prizes, and a live pack opening competition with cash prizes.
shows.vendor_description: Our biggest show yet. Tables fill up fast — lock in your spot early. Includes a 6ft table, two chairs, and early setup access from 8am.
